testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.HomeActivityTest

testcase.name: GIVEN a pending tab but no account WHEN resuming THEN keep the tab and show nothing
GIVEN active options page does not belong to an extension WHEN creating open options page directions THEN return null
GIVEN app is default browser WHEN maybeShowSetAsDefaultBrowserPrompt is called THEN do nothing
GIVEN should not show prompt WHEN maybeShowSetAsDefaultBrowserPrompt is called THEN do nothing
GIVEN a pending tab and a signed in account but saved state WHEN resuming THEN keep the tab and show nothing
navigateToBrowserOnColdStart in normal mode navigates to browser
GIVEN all conditions met WHEN maybeShowSetAsDefaultBrowserPrompt is called THEN dispatch action and record metrics
GIVEN active options page belongs to an extension WHEN creating open options page directions THEN return directions
GIVEN no saved state WHEN restoring THEN there is no pending tab
getIntentSource
isActivityColdStarted returns true for null savedInstanceState and not launched from history
GIVEN a pending tab in saved state and a signed in account WHEN restoring THEN the tab is restored
navigateToBrowserOnColdStart in private mode does not navigate to browser
isActivityColdStarted returns false for null savedInstanceState and launched from history
GIVEN a pending tab and a signed in account WHEN resuming THEN show the dialog and clear the pending tab
GIVEN the user is in the extension management UI WHEN opening an options page THEN suppress the request and clear activeOptionsPage
GIVEN a pending tab WHEN leaving sign in but now authenticated THEN keep the tab for the observer to handle
GIVEN the user has been away for a long time WHEN the user opens the app THEN do start on home
GIVEN a pending tab WHEN still moving within the sign in flow THEN keep the pending tab
GIVEN the user entered sign in WHEN they leave it without an account THEN drop the pending tab
isActivityColdStarted returns false for null savedInstanceState and not launched from history
isActivityColdStarted returns false for valid savedInstanceState and not launched from history
GIVEN the user is not in the extension management UI WHEN opening an options page THEN do not suppress the request
GIVEN the user has been away for a long time WHEN opening a link THEN do not start on home
GIVEN the user is on an addon options page WHEN opening an options page THEN suppress the request and clear activeOptionsPage
GIVEN a pending tab WHEN a destination changes before sign in is entered THEN keep the pending tab
GIVEN signed in WHEN a send to device intent arrives THEN show the dialog straight away
GIVEN signed out WHEN a send to device intent arrives THEN go to sign in and remember the tab
GIVEN build version too low WHEN maybeShowSetAsDefaultBrowserPrompt is called THEN do nothing
GIVEN native Android share sheet is supported WHEN handleNewIntent is called with QR code URI THEN qr_code_tapped telemetry is recorded
GIVEN native Android share sheet is not supported WHEN handleNewIntent is called with QR code URI THEN qr_code_tapped telemetry is not recorded
